_meta.description: Structured facts for muscles. Keyed by English base name (catalog.json `base`). Each field is { value, source } or { value: null, status: 'TODO' }. source 'z-anatomy' = derived automatically from Z-Anatomy attachment areas; anything else (e.g. 'expert:<name>', a textbook or Wikidata reference) is kept when the file is rebuilt.

fields.origin: Bones carrying the muscle's origin area (Z-Anatomy).
fields.insertion: Bones carrying the muscle's insertion area (Z-Anatomy).
fields.movementCategory: Z-Anatomy colour-code category of the attachment areas, e.g. Flexion. Not a full description of the action.
